title: Select AI roles and define business value
learner_promise: Match AI support to real work and defend a measurable value hypothesis, including a simpler no-AI alternative.

pacing.label: Choose roles and distinguish real value
Five-task AI role and value practice

outcomes: Select organizer, question generator, comparison partner, draft assistant, editor, rehearsal partner, or no AI based on the task.
Differentiate activity, output, usefulness and measurable value.
Classify five tasks by AI role, consequence and human review.
Compare an AI method with a simpler non-AI alternative, accounting for all review time.
Save an evidence-labeled value hypothesis to the continuing Project Record.

teaching.heading: Choose the support role, not the flashiest technology
paragraphs: Your selected Lesson 1.2 audience need provides the purpose. Choose the role for the task: organizer, question generator, comparison partner, draft assistant, editor, rehearsal partner, or no AI.
For an approved price or customer promise, a person must check the authorized record. A role describes assistance, never transferred decision authority.
teaching.think_prompt: Which step in your chosen project is worth AI support, and which step should remain a direct human check?

teaching.heading: Separate producing an output from creating value
paragraphs: Activity is work performed. An output is a document or answer produced. Usefulness helps a specific person. Value improves a relevant result compared with the baseline after checking corrections, costs, and effort shifted to other people.
Count full-cycle effort and correct decisions, not merely how quickly AI creates the first draft.
teaching.think_prompt: What business result would you measure to show usefulness rather than output volume?

teaching.heading: Compare AI against a simple non-AI alternative
paragraphs: An AI-drafted proposal can be compared with an already approved proposal template. Both must be judged against real total time, unsupported statements, quality and review obligations.
If baseline evidence is missing, write 'not yet measured'. An AI suggestion is a hypothesis, not proof of time savings.
teaching.think_prompt: What fair test would distinguish the two options?

teaching.heading: State a revisable value hypothesis
paragraphs: A professional value hypothesis names the person served, task, proposed support, baseline, expected improvement, measurement method, accountable reviewer, and evidence that would change the choice.
Open your own AI assistant with sanitized tasks, examine its recommendation, reject unsupported guarantees, and record what remains human.
teaching.think_prompt: What finding would cause you to narrow or remove AI from this task?

worked_case.label: Faster drafting does not automatically create business value
worked_case.setup: Fictional business owner: AI reduces proposal drafting by 20 minutes but invented promises require an additional 30 minutes to correct. The full job takes 10 minutes longer.

evidence_table.claim: The first draft took 20 minutes less
evidence_table.evidence: A fictional comparison of drafting activity only
evidence_table.action: Do not label as a complete-process saving

evidence_table.evidence: Fictional correction burden in the case
evidence_table.action: Include all review and rework time

evidence_table.evidence: False; net effect is 10 minutes longer
evidence_table.action: Compare both end-to-end methods and assess quality

evidence_table.claim: The AI option improves customer satisfaction
evidence_table.action: Mark as unknown; define a test before claiming value

worked_case.revised_example: The AI-supported draft was produced 20 minutes faster, but correction took 30 additional minutes. The full process therefore took 10 minutes longer in this fictional case; no additional business improvement has been established.
demonstration_steps: Select the narrow role or no-AI alternative.
Count initial drafting and all correction effort.
Compare the approved template with an AI draft.
Save a measured-or-estimated value hypothesis with a human reviewer.
worked_case.question: What measure demonstrates improvement to the person served rather than simply counting generated drafts?

application.heading: Classify five tasks by AI role and consequence
application.instruction: Record task, person served, role or no AI, human decision, likely benefit, review effort and uncertainty. Use your continuing project.
application.evidence: Five-task AI role table with at least one deliberately narrow or no-AI role.

application.heading: Compare with a simpler alternative
application.instruction: Use your chosen AI tool with sanitized notes. Compare a selected task's AI method against an approved template or another realistic no-AI approach. Review unsupported claims.
application.evidence: Baseline status, AI-versus-non-AI comparison and corrected AI statement.

application.heading: Write the business value hypothesis
application.instruction: State useful business measure, review owner, baseline, uncertainty and evidence that would make you change approach. Save to the same Project Record.
application.evidence: Evidence-labeled professional value hypothesis and change-of-mind condition.

approved_ai_request: Compare these five tasks by suitable AI support, human decision, likely benefit, added review effort and uncertainty. Include a no-AI option. Do not guarantee savings. Separate supplied facts from assumptions. Tasks: [sanitized task list].
responsibility_map_fields: Professional task and narrow AI role or no AI

verification.heading: Distinguish output from value
verification.prompt: Explain why 20 minutes faster drafting is not a business saving when correction adds 30 minutes.

verification.heading: Reject an unsupported promise
verification.prompt: Label the baseline as measured, estimated or unknown and identify an AI guarantee without proof.

verification.heading: Choose no AI when appropriate
verification.prompt: Name a task with a narrow role or no AI and explain which measure shows usefulness to the person served.

completion_criteria: Five appropriate task-role selections and human decisions
Baseline and full-cycle review costs clearly labeled
Specific useful business value measure and verifying owner
Saved provisional value hypothesis and no-AI justification
handoff: Lesson 1.4 will use the same project, five-task role table, and value hypothesis to improve requests with purpose, audience, context, task, constraints and quality.
